findings.title: WASM client encrypts null instead of passing it through
findings.label: valid
findings.note: New WasmEncryptionClient.encrypt accepts null (WasmPlaintext) and forwards it to wasmEncrypt with no guard, unlike the Node EncryptOperation null short-circuit.
